notes: DEBUG build, so these are an upper bound and not comparable to the release budgets in rules/render.md. Source: tests/unit/shaper_test.cpp "shaping throughput" ([.][bench], hidden by default). One screenful of DISTINCT text: 63 runs of 78 ASCII columns, nothing repeating, so the cold pass is a worst case no real session reaches. The warm pass re-shapes the identical runs and must come entirely from the ShapeCache.
gate: warm_ms < cold_ms is asserted by the bench itself. A regression of >5% on cold_ms is what perf-auditor should flag once a release-mode baseline replaces this one.
